verdict.rationale: Obsidian has a dedicated developer docs site with a 'Build a plugin' tutorial that compiles a sample plugin from source, an official API repository (obsidian-api) documenting interfaces like Vault, and TypeScript-based plugin development guidance; the registry-verified 7,275 community plugins confirm the extension API is actively used at scale. missing for 10: independent hands-on review of doc quality/completeness, and no official CLI/scaffolding tool beyond the sample build tutorial.
